content.rendered:
?.

Ezekiel 30:21 KJV
Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
??
I have broken and not “I will break”.

?There is a huge difference. It’s been settled. The matter of oppression was sealed long ago.
?The enemy’s strength was been seriously degraded, so weakened, he’s become so powerless he cannot pose any threat to you or your desires so long as you continually abide in Christ.

Walk ??and work in the consciousness that you are operating from a position of victory.✔

Even the enemy knows you cannot lose so long as you abide in Him.
Job 1:10 MSG
Why, no one ever had it so good! You pamper him like a pet, make sure nothing bad ever happens to him or his family or his possessions, bless everything he does – he can’t lose!✔
?
Whatever new strategies the enemy tries to apply, he cannot and will not prevail over you in Jesus name
